title: Oldest-style drummers: Cali Piggott and Dave Bailey
summary: Barnes names Cali Piggott as the most traditional drummer, then the talk turns to Dave Bailey, whom he does not remember.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
